overview.description: The Subversive Congressional Republicans Trading ETF (GOP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund seeks to broadly invest in stocks purchased or sold by Republican members of the US Congress and their families. GOP was launched on Feb 7, 2023 and is issued by Subversive.
